_meanings:
.²1 A maid-servant or female attendant in the womenʼs apartments [a woman
 of the mixed tribe described in {#sEranDra#} (2)].
.²2 An independent female artisan working in another personʼs house.
.²3 An epithet of Draupadī (assumed by her when she acted as servant to
 Sudeṣṇā, queen of Virāṭa).
